manifestSignature.trustBootstrap: An empty trust store fails closed. The first app containing the reviewed key must be installed through a trusted manual channel before production feeds are signed.
manifestSignature.keyRotation: Ship a new app with the new public key before signing manifests with it; retain old keys only for a bounded transition and remove revoked keys in a reviewed app update.
manifestSignature.replayProtection: Persist the highest accepted issuedAt and payload digest per channel; app-data clearing resets this best-effort client checkpoint.
